study.title: WeedsGalore: A Multispectral and Multitemporal UAV-based Dataset for Crop and Weed Segmentation in Agricultural Maize Fields
study.short_title: WeedsGalore UAV maize benchmark; DeepLabV3+ MSI mIoU 82.9

segmentation.domain: crop (maize) and weed semantic segmentation (3-class background/crop/weed and 6-class multi-species settings) plus instance segmentation baselines, on a multispectral (RGB + red-edge + NIR) multitemporal UAV dataset
models_tested: Probabilistic DeepLabv3+ (variational inference with MC dropout, p_d=0.5, K=5 forward passes)
segmentation.best_model: Probabilistic DeepLabv3+ (MC dropout) on 5-band MSI, 3-class: mIoU 0.8294, ECE 0.0018 (weeds IoU 0.7651, crop IoU 0.7390); deterministic DeepLabv3+ MSI mIoU 0.8290

dataset.name: WeedsGalore: maize crop/weed dataset, Marquardt, Potsdam, Germany (field ~1840 m2; publicly released)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral (5 monochrome sensors: B/G/R 450/560/650+-16 nm, RE 730+-16 nm, NIR 840+-26 nm + RGB), Hover&Capture, 70% side / 60% front overlap. ~1150 raw images; central 600x600 px crops from 48 locations (12 patches, 4 campaigns May 25/30 & Jun 6/15 2023; maize planted May 9 2023, rows 70 cm x 20 cm) annotated with Encord+SAM. 156 fully annotated images: 104 train / 26 val / 26 test (spatially disjoint 8/2/2 patches). Instances: 2,169 maize, 10,031 weeds (4,109 amaranth, 2,537 barnyard grass, 249 quickweed, 3,136 weed-other). Maps to ~128 m2 ground area per date; 4 large orthomosaics included unlabeled.

segmentation.backbone: ResNet50 (first conv layer re-initialized to 5 input channels for MSI)

mIoU.ambiguity: Best semantic score = probabilistic DeepLabv3+ (MC dropout) on 5-band MSI, 3-class setting: mIoU 82.94%, crop IoU 73.90%, weed IoU 76.51%, ECE 0.0018. Deterministic 3-class MSI: DeepLabv3+ 82.90%, MaskFormer 80.27%. 6-class (multi-species) best DeepLabv3+ MSI mIoU 55.52% (quickweed 21.11). OOD Maize2024 (prob.): mIoU 58.78%.

PA.ambiguity: IoU-based metrics only; per-class IoUs given (e.g. background 98.45, crop 72.93, weed 77.31 for deterministic DeepLabv3+ MSI).

weed_F1.ambiguity: No per-class F1; weed-class IoU reported (deterministic MSI 77.31, prob. 76.51; 6-class per-species IoUs in Table 4).

crop_F1.ambiguity: No per-class F1; crop (maize) IoU reported (deterministic MSI 72.93, prob. 73.90).

edge.framework: Adam (lr 1e-3 DeepLabv3+ / 3e-5 MaskFormer), batch 8, standard augmentation; trained on NVIDIA A100 GPU + Intel Xeon Ice Lake CPU 32 GB; no inference-speed reporting

issues: Dataset/benchmark paper; semantic/instance baselines are reference results, not a deployment study.
Worklist venue 'arXiv Preprint' used; paper is in fact published at IEEE/CVF WACV 2025 (DOI 10.1109/WACV61041.2025.00467) - noted for metadata reconciliation.
No PA/F1/Dice reported (IoU-based only); no edge deployment metrics.
OOD generalization benchmark (Maize2024): probabilistic DeepLabv3+ mIoU 58.78% (IoUcrop 50.37, IoUweed 57.32) vs 52.55% deterministic.
PhenoBench comparison: mIoU 29.33% on maize; underscores domain gap.
